subject: NimbusCommerce POC: pilot readiness, success metrics, model choices and fallback plan
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@nimbuscommerce.com>, Jorge Ruiz <jorge.ruiz@nimbuscommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: NimbusCommerce POC: pilot readiness, success metrics, model choices and fallback plan

Hi Samantha / Jorge —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get the trial started next week. I tried to capture the goals we discussed and a pragmatic model plan that balances accuracy, latency, and cost.

Goals / success criteria (from call)
- Reduce merchant support triage time by 40% (measured on ticket-handling workflows).
- Intent accuracy >= 90% on your verification set (intent label agreement with SMEs).
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 350ms for the API path you plan to use.
- Cost target: incremental token spend under $0.035 per user query on average (pilot budget constraint).

Suggested POC scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0: kickoff, data ingestion (sample anonymized ticket batch), scoring rubric and eval baseline.
- Week 1: deploy baseline open model + caching, run initial eval (5k queries).
- Week 2: iterate prompts and reranking; test Spanish/Portuguese subset; add fallback model for heavy-tail queries.
- Week 3: run acceptance eval, tune batching/kv-cache, measure latency/cost.
- Week 4: acceptance review and final recommendations + handoff doc.

Model selection (initial roster)
- Baseline (primary): Llama-3-13B (quantized execution on our Dedicated pool) — chosen for instruction-following quality and multi-lingual handling with your Spanish examples.
- Fallback candidate A: Redwood-lite-3B (4-bit quant) — lower-cost, fast inference for high-throughput fallback.
- Fallback candidate B: Mistral-Instruct-7B — alternative to validate differences on customer phrasing and long-tail correctness.

Multilingual plan
- Pilot will validate English + Spanish + PT-BR. We'll ask you for a 500–1,000 example bilingual slice (annotated for intent). If coverage looks good we expand samples in week 2.

Ownership
- Redwood AE / trial owner: Ben Carter — contract + logistics.
- Solutions & eval owner: Priyom Das — test harness, eval scripts, model rosters.
- Redwood engineering contact: me (Lukas) — infra routing, latency tuning, and SLO coordination.
- Nimbus point: Samantha (product) + Jorge (platform).

Attachments: I attached a one-page scope (nimbus_poc_scope_v1.pdf) and a blank model-eval spreadsheet (nimbus_model_eval_matrix.xlsx) for your team to populate.

Immediate next steps
1) Confirm kickoff window: proposed Tue Sep 21, 10am PT.
2) Share a 500-sample anonymized ticket set (CSV) and a short list of 10 high-priority intents by EOD Mon Sep 20.
3) I’ll send a short SOW for signatures (DocuSign) to enable Dedicated pool access.

If any of the success metrics above need adjusting, tell me now so we bake them into the acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Lukas Meyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@nimbuscommerce.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jorge Ruiz <jorge.ruiz@nimbuscommerce.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NimbusCommerce POC: pilot readiness, success metrics, model choices and fallback plan

Thanks Lukas — this is great, clean recap. Quick notes from our side:

- Kickoff: Tue Sep 21 10am PT works for the team.
- On the metrics: intent accuracy target is good but we need to include a weighted precision metric for our escalations bucket (false positives there are costly). Can you include precision@threshold as part of the eval?
- Language: Spanish is high priority; Portuguese is lower but nice-to-have. We can supply ~700 Spanish examples, and ~200 PT-BR.
- Procurement: we need a short SOW (1–2 pages) and a standard NDA appendix. Procurement will sign quickly but expects net-30 billing. Is that ok?
- Deployment: curious if the Dedicated pool is required for the trial or if hosted tier with region routing is possible — we have data residency needs for EU customers later, but for this POC US-hosted is fine.

Action for Redwood: include precision metric, confirm SOW + billing terms, and confirm whether the fallback model will run automatically on error/timeout or be invoked by a policy.

Samantha Lin
Product Lead — NimbusCommerce
samantha.lin@nimbuscommerce.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@nimbuscommerce.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusCommerce POC: pilot readiness, success metrics, model choices and fallback plan

Appreciate the notes, Samantha — I'll own procurement and SOW logistics. Quick clarifications from Redwood's side:

- Billing: Net-30 is acceptable for the pilot. I’ll add the SOW appendix for NDA/procurement.
- Deployment options: For the pilot we can do Hosted with region routing for US (faster ramp). If you need Dedicated later for predictable throughput we can switch; Dedicated provisioning can be added to the SOW as an optional line item.
- Fallback behavior: our recommendation is a policy-based fallback (automatic):
  - If latency p95 exceeds 750ms or model error rate (e.g., malformed output) is detected, route to the fallback model for that request path.
  - We can also enable explicit fallback on low-confidence scores returned by the primary model.

Model roster update: adding Mistral-Instruct-7B as a priority fallback candidate (Priyom will run a quick side-by-side in our sandbox). That gives you two distinct fallback behaviors to compare: a) lower-cost small model for throughput, b) alternate-architecture model for behavioral diversity.

I'll draft the SOW and loop procurement; expect a DocuSign link from me by EOD Tue Sep 21 after the kickoff.

— Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Perfect — thanks all. Finalizing a few action items before kickoff:

Action items
- Nimbus: share anonymized sample set (500–900 records) + escalation definition and examples — Samantha / Jorge (due Mon Sep 20 EOD).
- Redwood (Ben): SOW + NDA appendix + DocuSign (in progress; target Tue Sep 21 EOB).
- Redwood (Priyom): populate the eval matrix with the baseline and both fallback candidates; include precision@K, recall, and p95 latency columns.
- Redwood (Lukas): prepare infra plan and routing policy draft and link into the kickoff deck.

I’ll attach the kickoff agenda to the Drive link and send a calendar invite for Tue Sep 21 10am PT. See related links in the metadata. Looking forward to a focused kickoff.

Regards,

Lukas Meyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
